capabilities: , Convert notes and folders into books
Export manuscripts to EPUB, PDF, and DOCX
Design typography using styles and rules
extras: Free and open source. Requires external tools (Pandoc and LaTeX) for conversion.
problem: Users need a way to compile scattered Markdown notes into a cohesive, print-ready, and professionally formatted book manuscript.
summary: Bookbinder converts Markdown notes and folders into professionally formatted EPUB, PDF, and DOCX files, allowing users to design and export manuscripts from within Obsidian.
